from __future__ import annotations
from typing import Any
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    props_as_array: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    props_as_true: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    props_as_zero: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    items_false: list | None = None
    addl_array: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    addl_null: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    pattern_empty: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    pattern_falsy: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    type_number: Any = None
    type_mixed_array: str | Any | None = None
    required_bad: str | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            props_as_array=data.get("propsAsArray"),
            props_as_true=data.get("propsAsTrue"),
            props_as_zero=data.get("propsAsZero"),
            items_false=data.get("itemsFalse"),
            addl_array=data.get("addlArray"),
            addl_null=data.get("addlNull"),
            pattern_empty=data.get("patternEmpty"),
            pattern_falsy=data.get("patternFalsy"),
            type_number=data.get("typeNumber"),
            type_mixed_array=data.get("typeMixedArray"),
            required_bad=data.get("requiredBad"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "propsAsArray": self.props_as_array,
            "propsAsTrue": self.props_as_true,
            "propsAsZero": self.props_as_zero,
            "itemsFalse": self.items_false,
            "addlArray": self.addl_array,
            "addlNull": self.addl_null,
            "patternEmpty": self.pattern_empty,
            "patternFalsy": self.pattern_falsy,
            "typeNumber": self.type_number,
            "typeMixedArray": self.type_mixed_array,
            "requiredBad": self.required_bad,
        }
